description:
MECHANISM (measured 2026-08-31 at a0a92a8cb; recipes: stream joins on
/tmp-era captures, probes reverted): after fz-kdt.84, the remaining
zero-change analysis evals (72/43/37) are ~90% FunctionContract-caused
(65/72, 30/43, 33/37; ReturnType-caused collapsed to 1/0/0). The contract
facts are REAL content (100% first-claim-with-content -- fz-kdt.84's cold
review); the waste is ORDERING: function-local prerequisite facts
(FunctionContract, Recursive, DispatchMask -- the still-empty wake data
shows Recursive 58/22/22 and DispatchMask 29/11/35 in the same pattern) are
derived on DEMAND, i.e. only after an analysis that needs them has already
started -- guaranteeing one block-and-rerun (or one wake-and-rerun) per
(analysis, prerequisite) first encounter. When the arriving contract
refines nothing beyond current evidence, the whole-job re-run concludes
byte-identically.

## Design sketch (cold review before building)
PREFETCH AT IGNITION: the activation-frontier ignition path demands the
function-local prerequisite facts (contract, keying) through
demand_fact_producer BEFORE the first analysis run -- pull-shaped, existing
machinery, demand-scoped (only for functions actually entering the
frontier; no eager global derivation). First analysis then finds them
present: the 72/43/37 zero-change re-runs and a slice of the blocked churn
disappear by ordering.

## Questions for the cold review
1. The spec-less case: under exactly what condition does the analysis wait
   on FunctionContract (semantic.rs:~1666)? A non-declaring function claims
   no contract -- verify the wait is conditional and what satisfies it;
   prefetching a producer that publishes nothing must not wedge or churn.
2. Does prefetch change DEMAND semantics anywhere observable (products,
   settlement, zero-uncaused attribution -- an analysis's first run must
   still name its causes)?
3. Job-order baselines re-baseline once (deterministic) -- confirm the
   determinism pair self-consistency argument.
4. Is ignition the right site, or should require_activation_key_facts-style
   pre-demand live with the frontier note (world.rs note_activation_frontier)
   or the demand_fact_producer arm itself?
5. Honest ceiling: at most one rerun per (activation x prerequisite class)
   is saved -- measure the expected drop against the 72/43/37 + blocked
   share before building; if the ceiling is small relative to complexity,
   close with numbers instead.
title: Demand-driven prerequisites guarantee a block-and-rerun per analysis: prefetch at ignition
